answer: A bond is refunded only after 15 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The meadow counter is kept in dawn and marble exposes each reset. A hostile operator therefore has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 15 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. That bill is paid per identity, so 244 aliases cost 147 times the single-account price. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
